params.stableAmount: The amount of USDC/stablecoin to deposit.

returns.sharesMinted: The net amount of ALPHA shares minted.

params.sharesAmount: The amount of native shares/tokens to redeem.

returns.assetsReceived: The net amount of USDC/EURC stablecoins received.

deposit(uint256).notice: Allows an investor to deposit stablecoins to mint native ALPHA shares based on NAV.

disburseTreasuryLoan(address,uint256).notice: Disburses a Treasury reserve loan (up to 20% max of total reserves) to P2PLendingMarket.

getAssetBalance(address).notice: Returns the amount of specific asset held by the Treasury (including yield vaults).

getNAV().notice: Returns the Net Asset Value (NAV) of the Treasury in USD with 18 decimal places.

getNAVPerShare().notice: Returns the NAV per circulating share in USD with 18 decimal places.

getNetCirculatingShares().notice: Returns the net circulating shares excluding protocol-owned ALPHA.

mintCorporateFeeShares(uint256).notice: Allows RealYieldRouter to convert corporate fee shares into ALPHA tokens without triggering reentrancy locks.

notifyReserveFee(uint256).notice: Processes reserve fee revenue by executing open market swaps for 25% WBTC, 12.5% WETH, and 12.5% ALPHA (buy pressure), auto-staking the purchased ALPHA into GovernanceStaking.

processStakingFee(uint256).notice: Processes 1% staking entry fee ALPHA tokens, burning them and routing equivalent USDC yield to RealYieldRouter (50/25/25 flywheel).

rebalance().notice: Performs a rebalancing operation, realigning current weights to targets.

recordBurn(uint256).notice: Records the amount of tokens burned by external contracts (e.g. GovernanceStaking) to track total burned.

redeem(uint256).notice: Allows an investor to redeem shares directly for stablecoins based on the NAV.

releaseVaultPayout(address,uint256).notice: Allows VestedDiscountVault to request reimbursement payouts upon ragequit/maturity.

totalBurnedTokens().notice: Returns the total amount of burned tokens recorded by the Treasury.

validateSanityBounds().notice: Validates that the current portfolio weights are within the sanity bounds.
